02 / READ THE MECHANISM

HOLD. EARN. BUY BACK.
How does $OTCWheel work?

The mechanism allocates memecoin creator fees to buying $OTC and minting OTC Desk NFTs. The treasury holds and activates these desks, collects their available rewards, and uses the proceeds to buy back $OTCWheel. Fee allocation and execution details will be published alongside treasury activity.

What happens to the desks?

The treasury keeps the Desk NFTs so it can collect their future rewards. Desk ownership and activation status will be tracked separately. New desks are added when allocated fees cover the $OTC mint requirement, SOL charges, activation and transaction costs.

How do rewards become buybacks?

OTC desk rewards may be tokenized assets rather than SOL. The treasury collects available rewards and converts them into SOL or another supported trading asset before purchasing $OTCWheel. Only successful purchases count toward buybacks. Rewards, conversion liquidity and buyback amounts can vary; no fixed return or price increase is promised.

What happens to bought-back tokens?

Bought-back tokens are received by the treasury. Their subsequent use will be published separately. A buyback alone does not reduce the token's total supply.

Where can I verify the transactions?

Once tracking is connected, the activity log will link to fee collections, $OTC purchases, desk mints, reward collections, reward conversions and $OTCWheel buybacks. Duplicate and failed transactions will not increase the totals.

Why are the dashboard values blank?

Live tracking is not connected yet. Values will appear once the token and treasury are configured and transactions are verified. The artwork is illustrative; completed activity will be documented in the log.

Keep the desks in the treasury and activate them for eligible rewards.

Collect available desk rewards and convert assets into buyback funds.

05

Purchase our token on the open market and record the confirmed transaction.
